ev.q: I love how stressful it can get
Frostpunk is the first society survival game
manage both its citizens and infrastructure
Every decision you make can shape the way your city develops
As the ruler of the last city on Earth
Set in an alternate 1800s ice age
its steep learning curve and unique survival premise
its challenging at first, and you WILL fail
It has become a comfort game in effect to burn hours into
Frostpunk broke my heart in the coldest way
можно накормить людей опилками и заставить их работать без сна
Самая лучшая игра где можно отправить детей на шахты
какой же в этой игре прекрасный саундтрек
Просто рай и мед для ушей
